unit.why: A short anecdote: the rebbe's son finds him studying Zohar and Lurianic writings at the start of the night and questions him, and the rebbe answers.

stories.start_quote: פ"א בתחלת הלילה נכנס אל מורינו
stories.summary_en: His son R. Issachar Berish of Dolina enters at nightfall and finds the rebbe studying Zohar and the Ari's writings, against the known custom; the rebbe humbly answers that the custom binds only one still subject to time, while he is above time.

quotes: נכנס אל מורינו בנו הרה״ק מו"ה ישכר בעריש מדאלינא
tags.why: the tzaddik's son is the interlocutor

quotes: הלא מפורסם לכל שאין לומדים זאת בתחלת הלילה
tags.why: a custom restricting study at that hour is at issue
the answer is framed as humble, though its content is a claim of elevation
the tzaddik's special status places him beyond ordinary rules

quotes: זהו רק למי שמשועבד עוד תחת הזמן
tags.why: the scope of a practice rule is decided
